scope: Measured run receipts report CPU and wall time independently. Jobs shared the host, so wall times cannot be summed as total waiting time.

first_32_solid_inverse_error_envelope.replacement: Quadratic residual around the computed trial solutions and observer-direction covariance enclosure.

independent_replay_recovery: First Arb attempt represented exact Fourier coefficients by uniform worst-case independent binary64 entry intervals and was too wide. Recomputing coefficients directly as narrow 128-bit Arb DFT boxes resolved this. First-attempt CPU and wall not separately instrumented.
